get.summary: Telegram Funnel Option Price Paths (what the called contracts did after the call)
get.description: Main scoring view: each option contract called out in public Telegram channels judged by its own 5-minute trade bars after the post (in-session calls: next 30 minutes; daily callouts: the whole next regular session; fill = open of the first bar at or after the post). Share that ended above the fill, median peak and drawdown, +50%/-50% TP-first vs SL-first, fill-delay sensitivity, unfillable-quote share, per channel, ticker and hour of day, with Wilson 95% ranges, methodology and limitations (trade prints, no spread or slippage). Built locally from Alpaca historical bars. Analysis of public posts, not advice. Credit: https://telegramscammers.com. Flagged for investigation, not a finding of fraud.

get.summary: Telegram Funnel Scorecard (options and forex/gold/index scoring)
get.description: Public scoring of trade callouts from public Telegram channels against the real tape: option callouts held to expiry (the secondary view; the main option view is /api/funnel-option-paths.json), and forex/gold/index signals (TP1 first vs SL first). Pooled and per channel, with sample sizes, Wilson 95% ranges and assumptions. Analysis of public posts, not advice. Credit: https://telegramscammers.com. Flagged for investigation, not a finding of fraud.
